blocks.text: LOS ANGELES–Luka Doncic wants the blame placed on him after the Los Angeles Lakers’ nine-game winning streak ended with a shocking loss to the previously struggling Utah Jazz in the NBA on Wednesday night. Doncic wasn’t great despite his 29 points in the Lakers’ 109-97 defeat, missing 10 of his 12 3-point attempts and committing nine turnovers. His streak of 11 straight 30-point games also ended. Although the ugly game was the culmination of a punishing stretch played mostly at less than full strength by Los Angeles, the Slovenian superstar still feels a personal responsibility when he can’t will the Lakers […]...
